blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A purported bagman-turned-witness told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday that he ribbed one of the former members of so-called “Maleta boys” that he hit the jackpot when the latter told him that he allegedly got paid in exchange for recantation of his testimony. Rodante Orbillo made the revelation when he took the witness stand before the anti-graft court to testify in the bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez stemming from P7.44 billion worth of alleged kickbacks from infrastructure projects delivered by the purported bagmen.
